messages:
maria_sales: Heads-up: Quick POC with NovaTech at 3pm. Their bulk embeddings job keeps getting 429s during a stress run. Need a fast triage before demo. :grimacing:
devon_eng: Can you paste a failing req id and the client settings?
maria_sales: req id `nt-9001` (2024-08-02T14:12:13Z). They sent batch_size=50, concurrency=60, model=embed-large-3.
lucy_support: Pulling logs for nt-9001 now.
sam_infra: Log snippet:
```
[2024-08-02T14:12:13Z] req=nt-9001 acct=novatech key=sk-nova-7 status=429 reason=per_route_cap limit=100/min observed=104 concurrent=60 tokens=54000
X-RateLimit-Reset: 2024-08-02T14:12:45Z
```
devon_eng: They hit the per-route request cap due to big batches + concurrency spikes. Token burn is huge.
lucy_support: Immediate advice to NovaTech: 1) reduce concurrency to <=12 for demo, 2) lower batch_size to 8-12, 3) add exponential backoff with jitter on 429s.
maria_sales: Can we request a temporary bump for the demo window? They'll reimburse if needed.
sam_infra: We can raise per-route to 300/min for a 2-hour window. Need ops ticket with acct id and exact window.
ops_bot: [system] quota request template: account, start_iso, end_iso, reason.
maria_sales: Filing ticket now with acct=novatech-01 start=2024-08-02T14:45:00Z end=2024-08-02T16:45:00Z reason="demo".
lucy_support: Also suggest client fallback to embed-lite on retries to reduce token pressure. That keeps demo responsive if heavy model hits cap.
maria_sales: Thanks — I'll update NovaTech to throttle client and enable backoff while ticket is processed. Will report back in 10m. :thumbsup:
